जठर,
 I. adj., f. रा.
 1. Hard, Śāntiś. 4, 13.
 2. Old, Śiś. 4, 29(?).
 II. m.
 1. The belly, Pañc. i. d. 27.
 2. The womb, Bhāg.

.
 --Cf. probably Lat. venter; γαστήρ; Goth. qvithra and in-kiltho.

जाठर, i. e. जठर + अ,
 I. adj., f. री,
 1. Of the belly, Mārk.

. With अग्नि,
 a. The digestive power,

.
 b. Hunger, Pañc. ii. d. 193.
 II. m. A child, Bhāg.
